title: M&A announcement returns for acquirer firms
research_question: Do acquirer firms experience negative cumulative abnormal returns around M&A announcement dates, consistent with the acquirer's curse hypothesis?
data_description: Event study data for 80 acquiring firms. Variables: stock_id, event_day (−10 to +10), ret, mkt_ret, beta. Market model estimated on [−10,−2]. Event window [−1,+1]. Focus on whether acquirer CAR is significantly different from zero.

ground_truth.identification_strategy: Event study with cross-sectional CAR regression; acquirer returns tested against zero
ground_truth.conclusion_detail: Acquirers experience small negative CAR, consistent with overpayment hypothesis
